semantics.allocation: string-keyed positive point entries preserve request order; zero entries are omitted on a successful set
semantics.town_gate: the caller supplies town position and hub circle; the boundary is inclusive
semantics.invalid_request: not-in-town, empty key, negative point, duplicate key in the typed projection, and over-budget requests preserve the prior allocation
semantics.respec: cost is the sum of absolute per-key point changes, with the three source payment tiers
